standGroup.trigger: after moveDuration + standDuration for RunEndJump segment

notes: Clip tracks are ABSOLUTE local TRS values relative to the square Animation component game object. Apply them to the named node; do not multiply them as extra deltas. Unbound paths are ignored by Unity and are explicitly listed per slot.
matrixInNormalPrefab includes Root Y45 and excludes prefab root scale0.9, matching grid-hooks.json.
Plain passing/landing uses ani_gezi_jingguo / ani_gezi_stop, at PIECE_MOVE_SPEED_RATE=1.5. There are no ani_gezi_come/ani_gezi_pass ordinary calls.

BuddyTrick animation groups play all listed tracks simultaneously at PIECE_JUMP_SPEED_RATE=1. Delays are authored INSIDE distinct shake clip curves; no separate delay field exists in AnimationGroupTrack.
Only ordinary enter/stop clips plus actual BuddyTrick stand/jump group clips are exported. FriendRent and other gameplay actions are outside this export.
Per-slot availableClips comes from the original bundled Animation reference list. Source .anim curves and source prefab AnimationGroup list are kept with their paths for verification.
Infinite scalar slopes are stored as the string Infinity or -Infinity; treat these as stepped/constant segments.

Hermite key slopes/tangentMode/weights are preserved. Quaternion components must be normalized after interpolation. Float curves are retained separately with exact attribute and classID; some animate material properties, not TRS.
